This page records an e-mail from [[Jason Fry]] for reference purposes in use with the [[Bulwark Mark III]] article. Fry's comments are recorded here for posterity. This page has been locked from editing.
{{Excerpt|<em>
My question has to do with the "Bulwark Mark III battlecruiser," as detailed in the book's "The Defender and the New Class Programs" section on page 207, if that helps any for your reference. I was hoping you might be able to confirm whether it was your intention for the Mark III to be the same "''Bulwark''-class battle cruiser" from the old ''Star Wars: Rebellion'' video game.
</em>|source=E-mail|attrib=[[User:Toprawa and Ralltiir|Toprawa and Ralltiir]]}}
{{Excerpt|<em>
Hey [name redacted], yes, that's right. I was looking to canonize Dan Wallace's plans for the evolution of the class, which he'd discussed but never had a chance to make formally so. Hope that helps. Thanks and best, J
</em>|source=Email|attrib=[[Jason Fry]]}}
